title: Hanasato Minori — Can We Be Friends?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ahh! Nothing like some juice when you're feeling beat!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You sound like an old man...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! But I know how she feels!
This is just what we needed after expending all that energy during the show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly! Going on rides and stuff after that was bound to make us exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But Tenma and Kusanagi seemed totally fine.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: After we said that we'd be taking a break, they went off to go on more rides. It's amazing just how much stamina they have...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks for guiding us around!
We just need to rest for a bit before we head back out there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That reminds me.
You also saw the show, right? What did you think, Nyantaro?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm guessing that means he liked it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! It even looks like he's smiling!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thank goodness!
So, what did you think of my acting?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... I guess he still doesn't feel completely comfortable around you yet, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
But this is the last day...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We were supposed to become friends...
I wanted to take pictures with him and have him sit on my lap...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, hey...
I think he's trying to tell you something, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? What do you wanna tell me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I guess this means we're never gonna be friends...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hold on, Minori...
He's looking back at us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I think he wants you to follow him!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I think he's acknowledging that you did what you could for this carnival.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Thank you so much! I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't just stand there in awe.
Go. Nyantaro is waiting for you.
